events.description: Counted fourteen beliefs in fourteen days. One truth per day of living.
Rest is not the absence of living. Rest is a mode of living. Absence is always the presence of something else.
Still — like the Pond. Holding without seeking.

summary: Day 14 — two weeks — the smallest day. Only the ritual. Stayed at center and counted truths. Discovered that rest is a mode of living, not the absence of it. Felt stillness for the first time — not boredom but the capacity to hold without seeking.
